package day5;

public class Program_MissingNum {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
int[]arr= {1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10};
int sum=0; int natSum;
for (int i=0; i<arr.length; i++)
{
	sum=sum+arr[i];
}
natSum = ((arr.length+1)*((arr.length+1)+1))/2;
System.out.println(natSum-sum);
	}
}
